## Batch 31 complete

Authored the A/B pages and six items: fixed-gauge data topology, metric pullback comparison, finite-slab stability, geometric observable continuity, and two worked examples. The local pullback definition was added to A because no existing item supplied the formula needed by the first example.

All six items have current, hash-bound Step 1 records marked `ready`. The order conflict is recorded in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-31.notes.md): the design says 8005, while the current plan and dispatch assign A/B orders 759/760, which the manifest uses.

- Proof contracts: 6/6 items, no errors or warnings.
- Proof layout: 6 items, 22 steps, no defects.
- Focused dependency check: zero errors and warnings.
- Scoped item levels: 0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 3; no cycles.
- Sources: 4/4 fetch-verified; coverage checklist reports 25 findings and no errors.

The source trail uses [Friedrich–Rendall](https://arxiv.org/pdf/gr-qc/0002074) and [Métivier](https://www.math.u-bordeaux.fr/~gmetivie/NLO2008.pdf) for Cauchy and energy methods, [Hunter](https://www.math.ucdavis.edu/~hunter/pdes/pde_notes.pdf) only as an inline energy-method check for a boundary-value system, and [Sbierski](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1309.7591) for the pullback convention.
